videos.title: The Pound for Pound Podcast Episode 8: Cvetan Gashevski, 6x World Champion
videos.summary:
Pound for Pound Podcast Episode 8: Ryan Bowen sits down with Bulgarian legend Cvetan Gashevski, 6x World Champion, 10x European Champion and master technician, universally considered one of the greatest pound for pound armwrestlers of all time.

Cvetan is fresh off winning the World Series of Armwrestling after a 10-minute final with Vrez Sedrakyan. We talk about his start in 1990, his first world and European medals in 1994, how elbow problems turned him into the best defensive top roller in the world, a week of training with Bob Brown, his six-days-a-week table time, his eight-minute war in Japan, Ryan's own exhausting match against him in India, what makes Team Mali so strong, his son's silver medal at the Junior Worlds, and why tiny Bulgaria keeps producing world-class armwrestlers.
